title: mesh-bus-egress-tcp
description: Config for a plain TCP egress exit. Constructed by mesh-bus-runtime from EgressCfg::Tcp.

id.description: Unique ExitId for this egress within the bus.

timeout_ms.description: Connect and write timeout in milliseconds. Upstream reads are continuous byte-stream forwarding, not request-response reads.

socket_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_RCVBUF size in bytes applied before TCP connect.

socket_send_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_SNDBUF size in bytes applied before TCP connect.

stream_model.description: TCP egress treats upstream bytes as an RFC-aligned bidirectional byte stream. send() writes client bytes; poll() returns independently produced upstream chunks.

close_semantics.description: Close and Cancel frames remove the cached per-session stream without upstream read/write.

shutdown_write_semantics.description: ShutdownWrite shuts down only the upstream TCP write half and leaves the read half available for return streaming.
